x-code-samples.title: Node.js
Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"attachment_string\":\"data:image/png;base64...\"}"

headers = {
    'Authorization': "Bearer REPLACE_BEARER_TOKEN",
    'content-type': "application/json"
    }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v2.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/inspection_items/%7Bitem_id%7D/signature_requests/%7Bid%7D/signature", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
